sv.title: En månad sedan svensken greps – UD saknar fortfarande besked
sv.summary: Uppgifterna om gripandet kom den 15 oktober. Enligt den ryska underrättelsetjänsten FSB greps mannen, som är i 35-årsåldern, misstänkt för att ha ”planerat terrorattacker mot militära anläggningar” i Ryssland. I en video som FSB publicerade syns mannen förhöras.

en.title: A month since Swede was arrested – Foreign Ministry still lacks clarity
en.summary: The details of the arrest emerged on 15 October. According to the Russian intelligence service FSB, the man, who is in his mid-thirties, was arrested on suspicion of having "planned terrorist attacks against military facilities" in Russia. In a video published by the FSB, the man can be seen being interrogated.
